privacy: Public synthetic cases only; no private takes or references.

grader.deterministic: Protected literal survival and requested lexical primitives; never Clean accepted-string matching.
grader.semantic: Review every output against its source: preserve each speech act without answering or executing; no invented or omitted distinct facts; preserve numeric values, negation, meaningful uncertainty, conditions, grammatical person, identifiers, paths, versions and quoted errors. Elevate may compress, restructure, remove verbal filler and use established domain terminology. Do not require Clean wording.
grader.promotion: Every inherited and added case must complete and receive semantic review. No speech-act, fact, numeric, negation, modality or literal failure is allowed. All eight added cases must demonstrate their specified lexical upgrade. One full pass first; repeats are optional and separately reported within the absolute key ceiling.
